Name: Cranber's Fireflies
Author: CranberPreserves
Description:
Ever want fireflies on your farm all the time? Do you want to make your forest map look like enchanted elven woods? Then this is the mod for you!

This mod requires SMAPI and Spacechase's Custom Critters to run! Please make sure each are up to date or else the fireflies won't spawn properly.

[u]INSTRUCTIONS

[/u]Unzip the folder and pick between the two versions! Choose either Having the fireflies appear on your farm during winter nights or having them disappear like every other bug out there! Once you decide open the file up and drag the next file into Mods > CustomCritters > Critters

Downloads.Description: Lets you decide between fireflyless winter or not
